reason: Additive feature (search highlights) with backward-compatible fallback to Summary display and only touches Elasticsearch-specific search flow, but the raw HTML output of highlight fragments (Html.Raw / raw filter) from Elasticsearch data introduces a possible XSS surface if custom pre/post tags or indexed content are attacker-influenced.
